scenes.title: Faithful Tentmakers in Corinth
scenes.english_text: Aquila and his wife Priscilla were faithful Jewish believers who moved to the city of Corinth after being forced to leave Rome. They were skilled tentmakers who worked hard each day with their hands, serving God and welcoming visitors into their home with warm hearts.
scenes.tetum_translation: Áquila no nia feen Priscila mak fiar-na'in Judeu ne'ebé laran-metin, ne'ebé muda ba sidade Corinto no sai husi Roma tanba ukun-fuan. Sira hatene halo tenda no servisu aat loron ba loron ho sira-nia liman, serví Maromak no simu bainaka sira iha sira-nia uma ho laran-manas.
scenes.scene_summary: Priscilla and Aquila work as skilled tentmakers in Corinth, honoring God through faithful daily labor and hospitality.

scenes.title: Partnering with Paul in Gospel Ministry
scenes.english_text: When the apostle Paul arrived in Corinth, he stayed and worked with Priscilla and Aquila because they shared the same trade. Together, they stitched tents during the week and shared the good news of Jesus Christ with boldness in the synagogues and markets.
scenes.tetum_translation: Bainhira apostolu Paulu to'o iha Corinto, nia hela no servisu hamutuk ho Priscila no Áquila tanba sira mak halo tenda hanesan. Hamutuk, sira sukut tenda iha semana laran no fahe lia-foun di'ak kona-ba Jesus Kristu ho brani iha mezkita no merkadu sira.
scenes.scene_summary: Paul joins Priscilla and Aquila in tentmaking and gospel outreach, building a deep spiritual partnership.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, apostle Paul with Priscilla and Aquila sitting around a wooden work table with rolls of cloth and tools, smiling and discussing happily while stitching a tent. scenes.title: Gently Guiding Apollos in Truth
scenes.english_text: In Ephesus, Priscilla and Aquila heard an eloquent preacher named Apollos speaking passionately about Jesus, but he only understood John's baptism. Loving him as a brother, they invited Apollos to their home and gently explained the way of God to him more accurately.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha Éfeso, Priscila no Áquila rona katuas-lisaun ho lia-foun ida naran Apolos ne'ebé ko'alia ho laran-manas kona-ba Jesus, maibé nia hatene de'it Joaun nia batizmu. Ho domin hanesan maun-alin, sira konvida Apolos ba sira-nia uma no esplikasaun ho kmaan Maromak nia dalan ba nia ho laran-loos liután.
scenes.scene_summary: Priscilla and Aquila invite Apollos into their home to teach him the full truth of Jesus with wisdom and kindness.

scenes.title: Opening Their Home as a Church
scenes.english_text: Wherever Priscilla and Aquila lived, they opened their house for believers to gather, worship God, and share meals. Their home became a vibrant house church where early Christians were encouraged, prayed together, and grew strong in faith.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha ne'ebé de'it Priscila no Áquila hela, sira loke sira-nia uma ba ema fiar-na'in sira atu halibur, adora Maromak, no fahe hahán. Sira-nia uma sai kréreka uma laran ne'ebé manas, iha ne'ebé ema Kristian uluk hetan ksolok, reza hamutuk, no sai brani iha fiar.
scenes.scene_summary: Priscilla and Aquila host a house church in their home, creating a warm place of worship and fellowship.

scenes.title: Enduring Legacy of Courageous Faith
scenes.english_text: Priscilla and Aquila risked their lives to protect Paul and serve the Lord faithfully. Paul and all the churches among the Gentiles expressed deep gratitude for their selflessness, unity, and unwavering love for Christ.
scenes.tetum_translation: Priscila no Áquila tau sira-nia moris iha risku atu proteje Paulu no serví Na'i ho laran-metin. Paulu no kréreka hotu iha ema Gentiu sira nia klaran fo agradesimentu boot ba sira-nia laran-di'ak, unidade, no domin boot ba Kristu.
scenes.scene_summary: The early churches give thanks for Priscilla and Aquila's brave service, unity, and dedication to God.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Priscilla and Aquila show us how married couples and friends can serve God together through hard work, hospitality, and encouraging others in truth.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Priscila no Áquila hatudu mai ita oinsá kaben-na'in no belun sira bele serví Maromak hamutuk troka servisu susar, laran-di'ak simu bainaka, no fó ksolok ba ema seluk iha lia-loos.
reflection.discussion_question_en: How can you use your home, talents, or teamwork with friends to welcome others and share God's love?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Oinsá ó bele uza ó-nia uma, talentu, ka servisu hamutuk ho belun sira atu simu ema seluk no fahe Maromak nia domin?
